"""Run final gates only after the actual independent technical round closes."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

root = Path('/workspace/tiny-perceptron-vlm')
state = json.loads(Path('/tmp/technical-round-coordinator-state.json').read_text())
assert len(state['completed_pass']) == 248
for key in ['active', 'awaiting_author', 'pending_recheck', 'recheck_active', 'format_pending']:
    assert not state.get(key), (key, state.get(key))
sha = lambda raw: hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
tracked = sorted(set(
    list((root / 'course').rglob('*.md'))
    + list((root / 'course/figures').glob('*.svg'))
    + list((root / 'notebooks').rglob('*.ipynb'))
    + list((root / 'tiny_perceptron').rglob('*.py'))
    + list((root / 'scripts/course_experiments').rglob('*.py'))
))
before = {path.relative_to(root).as_posix(): sha(path.read_bytes()) for path in tracked}
for lesson, consumed in state['completed_pass'].items():
    path = root / f'docs/technical-reviews/{lesson}.json'
    assert sha(path.read_bytes()) == consumed['report_sha256']
    report = json.loads(path.read_bytes())
    assert report['verdict'] == 'pass' and report['reviewer_task'] == consumed['task']
env = os.environ | {'OMP_NUM_THREADS': '1', 'MKL_NUM_THREADS': '1'}
commands = [
    ['.venv/bin/python', 'scripts/build_course.py', '--check'],
    ['.venv/bin/python', 'scripts/check_course_reviews.py'],
    ['.venv/bin/python', 'scripts/check_technical_reviews.py'],
    ['.venv/bin/python', 'docs/review-tools/check_review_round.py', '--output', 'outputs/final-review-round.json'],
    ['python3', '/tmp/check-actual-review-dispatches.py', '--stage', 'all', '--output', 'outputs/final-review-dispatches.json'],
    ['python3', '/tmp/check-current-notebook-kernels.py', '--output', 'outputs/final-notebook-identities.json'],
]
records = []
for command in commands:
    started = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)
    record = {'command': command, 'started_at': started, 'finished_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'exit_code': result.returncode, 'stdout': result.stdout, 'stderr': result.stderr}
    records.append(record)
    print(json.dumps({'command': command, 'exit_code': result.returncode}), flush=True)
    if result.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False))
assert before == {path.relative_to(root).as_posix(): sha(path.read_bytes()) for path in tracked}, 'Source changed during final gates'
student_path = root / 'docs/course-experiments/student-checks/all-models-validation.json'
student = json.loads(student_path.read_bytes())
assert student['status'] == 'passed' and student['models'] == 30 and student['checkpoints'] == 120 and student['executed_commands'] == 148
assert student['manifest_sha256'] == sha((root / 'docs/course-experiments/public-models.json').read_bytes())
for record in student['records']:
    assert record['sha256'] == sha((root / record['report']).read_bytes())
for path, expected in student['formal_training_code_file_hashes_at_runtime'].items():
    assert expected == sha((root / path).read_bytes())
receipt = {
    'schema_version': 1,
    'checked_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'checkout_revision': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=root, text=True).strip(),
    'status': 'passed',
    'scope': 'Actual final build/content/introduction/new-task-identity/real-dispatch and notebook-receipt gates after all248 original technical results were genuinely consumed. Source bytes remained unchanged throughout these checks. This is an evidence registry and automated gate, not a new reader or factual verdict, a fresh notebook kernel execution, remote Colab execution, actual paid-compute invoice, or proof of publication. Historical anonymous30-model/120-checkpoint/148-command CPU runtime proof and24 core source identities are verified without rewriting their dates or rerunning training.',
    'commands': records,
    'unchanged_source_sha256': before,
    'actual_current_technical_consumption': state['completed_pass'],
    'student_runtime_proof': {'path': student_path.relative_to(root).as_posix(), 'sha256': sha(student_path.read_bytes()), 'unchanged_core_files': len(student['formal_training_code_file_hashes_at_runtime'])},
    'verification_program': Path(__file__).read_text(),
}
target = root / 'docs/validation-artifacts/final-review-closure.json'
assert not target.exists(), 'Preserve any prior actual closure before another run'
target.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'status': 'passed', 'technical_results': 248, 'source_files_unchanged': len(before), 'output': target.relative_to(root).as_posix()}))
